usage: analyze_recorded_trace.py [-h] directory

Attribute recorded MOT misses to sensing or publication, evaluation only.

positional arguments:
  directory

optional arguments:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit

usage: audit_geometric_observability.py [-h] --capture CAPTURE
                                        --trace-directory TRACE_DIRECTORY

Evaluation-only check: 2D-box LiDAR support versus true 3D actor-box hits. A
LiDAR return projected inside a vehicle's image box may hit a background
building. This audit uses held-out CARLA boxes only to diagnose that
ambiguity. It does not modify the detector, tracker, estimator, or existing
MOT protocol.

optional arguments:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --capture CAPTURE
  --trace-directory TRACE_DIRECTORY

usage: audit_saved_mot_detector.py [-h] --capture CAPTURE [--model MODEL]
                                   [--device DEVICE] [--geometry-only]

Evaluation-only MOT detector audit for a previously recorded LVIMOT Fast run.
Runs YOLO+LiDAR detection ONLY on frames with CARLA-evaluation-eligible
actors. Does NOT start CARLA, rerun localization, update a map, or give GT to
detector. Windows usage from CARLA_LVIMOT-main:
.venv_live38\Scripts\python.exe audit_saved_mot_detector.py --capture
"outputs_carla\live\sensor_recordings\capture_20261020_085053_922129" For an
environment lacking YOLO, --geometry-only verifies GT observability and writes
a report without inference. Only inference mode can diagnose YOLO misses.

optional arguments:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --capture CAPTURE
  --model MODEL
  --device DEVICE
  --geometry-only

usage: capture_independent_scene_reference.py [-h] --capture CAPTURE --output
                                              OUTPUT [--host HOST]
                                              [--port PORT]
                                              [--spacing-m SPACING_M]
                                              [--radius-m RADIUS_M]

Render an independent 360-degree CARLA scene reference along a saved route.
Four overlapping depth/semantic views are placed at the recorded LiDAR origin.
Only evaluation reference data is written. Original sensors, estimated poses,
tracking, and map state are never modified. Existing actors/processes remain.
All sensor images and exact capture transforms are saved for offline reuse.

optional arguments:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --capture CAPTURE
  --output OUTPUT
  --host HOST
  --port PORT
  --spacing-m SPACING_M
  --radius-m RADIUS_M

usage: evaluate_ground_surface_candidates.py [-h] --capture CAPTURE
                                             --trace-directory TRACE_DIRECTORY
                                             --reference-directory
                                             REFERENCE_DIRECTORY

Evaluate sensor-only horizontal ground candidates against CARLA semantics.

optional arguments:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --capture CAPTURE
  --trace-directory TRACE_DIRECTORY
  --reference-directory REFERENCE_DIRECTORY

usage: evaluate_independent_scene_geometry.py [-h] --capture CAPTURE
                                              --rolling-world ROLLING_WORLD
                                              --reference-directory
                                              REFERENCE_DIRECTORY --output
                                              OUTPUT
                                              [--accumulated-local ACCUMULATED_LOCAL]
                                              [--protocol PROTOCOL]

Score rolling and accumulated LVIMOT geometry against independent CARLA depth.
The primary map is placed with the first recorded pose only. A fitted rigid
alignment is an additional diagnostic and never changes the sensor map.
Reference semantics measure category coverage, not invented mapper labels.

optional arguments:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --capture CAPTURE
  --rolling-world ROLLING_WORLD
  --reference-directory REFERENCE_DIRECTORY
  --output OUTPUT
  --accumulated-local ACCUMULATED_LOCAL
  --protocol PROTOCOL

usage: evaluate_recorded_scene_tracking.py [-h] --capture CAPTURE
                                           --trace-directory TRACE_DIRECTORY
                                           --static-reference STATIC_REFERENCE

Separate, explicitly defined whole-scene MOT evaluation of saved sensor
tracks. The original NPC-only MOTA remains unchanged in
validation_summary.json. This additional protocol includes CARLA's static
parked vehicles and requires actual 3D actor-box LiDAR hits, rather than
background hits inside a 2D rectangle. Known actors without sufficient current
measured depth define ignore regions; only an RGB match plus a nearby 3D
hypothesis can be ignored. No estimator runs.

optional arguments:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --capture CAPTURE
  --trace-directory TRACE_DIRECTORY
  --static-reference STATIC_REFERENCE

usage: export_carla_evaluation_reference.py [-h] --output OUTPUT [--host HOST]
                                            [--port PORT]

Read original CARLA static vehicle boxes and sensor defaults for evaluation.
This program only queries the server. It does not tick, load a world, change
settings, spawn actors, enable objects, or feed data to LVIMOT estimation.

optional arguments:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --output OUTPUT
  --host HOST
  --port PORT

usage: export_original_carla_map.py [-h]

One-click reference map export from the latest LVIMOT recorded route. Requires
running CARLA 0.9.13 Town10HD_Opt and a previously saved capture. Produces an
independent observed-area PLY, NOT the entire Unreal world mesh. Reference
poses are used ONLY here for evaluation; never in LVIMOT mapping.

optional arguments:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit

usage: refit_traffic_context.py [-h] --features FEATURES --feature-model
                                FEATURE_MODEL --expected-feature-sha256
                                EXPECTED_FEATURE_SHA256 --output OUTPUT

Reproduce the shipped linear classifier from frozen training features. The
feature archive contains only supervised training examples. This command does
not tune thresholds or read evaluation recordings. Image embedding provenance
and the separate validation results are supplied in the model card.

optional arguments:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --features FEATURES
  --feature-model FEATURE_MODEL
  --expected-feature-sha256 EXPECTED_FEATURE_SHA256
  --output OUTPUT

usage: regenerate_offline_html.py [-h] --output-dir OUTPUT_DIR
                                  [--capture-if-missing]
                                  [--require-full-reference]
                                  [--html-output HTML_OUTPUT]

Regenerate an honest offline CARLA-vs-LVIMOT 3D comparison for one run.
Examples: python tools/regenerate_offline_html.py --output-dir
outputs_carla/live python tools/regenerate_offline_html.py --output-dir
outputs_carla/live --capture-if-missing --require-full-reference A complete
CARLA scene comparison requires a separately rendered, independent 360-degree
depth reference of THIS recorded route. The OpenDRIVE road-only PLY is
deliberately not accepted as a full CARLA map. Ground truth is used here only
AFTER estimation; no estimator inputs or evaluation scores are changed.

optional arguments:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --output-dir OUTPUT_DIR
                        Folder with the final run offline_4d_map.ply,
                        offline_4d_scene.json and live_results.json
  --capture-if-missing  Render the exact recorded route using a running CARLA
                        server if 360 reference is absent
  --require-full-reference
                        Fail rather than create a misleading road-only CARLA
                        map
  --html-output HTML_OUTPUT
                        Save a standalone HTML copy here while reading the
                        original completed run

usage: replay_mota_regression.py [-h] --capture CAPTURE --output OUTPUT
                                 [--disable-tiles] [--disable-traffic-context]
                                 [--project PROJECT]
                                 [--minimum-mota MINIMUM_MOTA] [--no-gt]
                                 [--limit LIMIT] [--reference REFERENCE]

Offline sensor replay with stage evidence, source hashes and optional
regression gates. Use --project to replay an unmodified baseline project, then
rerun normally with --reference BASELINE/summary.json. --no-gt exercises the
evaluation boundary. --disable-traffic-context is a causal ablation, not an
original-ZIP baseline. Output must be outside the read-only capture. This tool
never connects to CARLA.

optional arguments:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --capture CAPTURE
  --output OUTPUT
  --disable-tiles
  --disable-traffic-context
  --project PROJECT     Alternative baseline project root; defaults to this
                        project
  --minimum-mota MINIMUM_MOTA
                        Fail unless original-protocol MOTA is at least this
                        fraction
  --no-gt
  --limit LIMIT
  --reference REFERENCE
                        Baseline summary.json from the identical capture

usage: replay_saved_capture.py [-h] --capture CAPTURE
                               [--detector {camera_lidar,lidar}]
                               [--model MODEL] [--device DEVICE]
                               [--output OUTPUT]

Replay an LVIMOT raw-sensor archive OFFLINE; does not connect to CARLA. Usage
(Windows, from CARLA_LVIMOT-main): .venv_live38\Scripts\python.exe
tools\replay_saved_capture.py --capture
outputs_carla\live\sensor_recordings\capture_YYYY... For true reproduction of
camera+LiDAR MOT, keep --detector camera_lidar. Use --detector lidar for GPU-
free localization/map debugging (MOT then differs).

optional arguments:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --capture CAPTURE
  --detector {camera_lidar,lidar}
  --model MODEL
  --device DEVICE
  --output OUTPUT

usage: run_recorded_validation.py [-h] --capture CAPTURE --output OUTPUT
                                  --cache-directory CACHE_DIRECTORY
                                  [--reference REFERENCE]
                                  [--without-gt-evaluation]
                                  [--yolo-image-size YOLO_IMAGE_SIZE]
                                  [--yolo-model YOLO_MODEL]

Reproducible sensor-only replay with cached RGB inference and diagnostic
traces. RGB inference caches contain image detections only. Simulator ground
truth is kept in separate evaluation fields and is never part of a cache key
or detector input. No CARLA server is contacted by this program.

optional arguments:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --capture CAPTURE
  --output OUTPUT
  --cache-directory CACHE_DIRECTORY
  --reference REFERENCE
  --without-gt-evaluation
  --yolo-image-size YOLO_IMAGE_SIZE
                        Explicit RGB inference resolution override; included
                        in cache provenance
  --yolo-model YOLO_MODEL
                        Explicit local weights override; SHA recorded in cache
                        provenance

usage: validate_carla_depth_reference.py [-h] --capture CAPTURE
                                         [--replay-output REPLAY_OUTPUT]
                                         [--host HOST] [--port PORT]
                                         [--timeout TIMEOUT]
                                         [--pixel-stride PIXEL_STRIDE]
                                         [--max-range-m MAX_RANGE_M]
                                         [--evaluate-existing-reference]

Capture an independent CARLA rendered-depth reference and score LVIMOT's map.
This is an evaluation-only tool. It reads the saved route's CARLA poses solely
to place a depth camera and align the completed sensor-estimated map after the
fact. It never feeds CARLA geometry or GT into LVIMOT estimation, tracking, or
mapping. It re-renders only the recorded observed region; it cannot validate
untraversed parts of Town10HD_Opt. Run from the project root while a CARLA
0.9.13 server is available: .venv_live38\Scripts\python.exe
tools\validate_carla_depth_reference.py --capture
outputs_carla\live\sensor_recordings\capture_20261020_085053_922129

optional arguments:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --capture CAPTURE
  --replay-output REPLAY_OUTPUT
  --host HOST
  --port PORT
  --timeout TIMEOUT
  --pixel-stride PIXEL_STRIDE
  --max-range-m MAX_RANGE_M
  --evaluate-existing-reference
                        Reuse the previously captured CARLA depth PLY; do not
                        connect to or tick CARLA.
